items.title: Ella Langley sweeps Country Music Awards as Taylor Swift returns for 1st performance in 13 years
chats: Did you catch the CMAs last night? Taylor Swift performed!
No way, her first CMAs performance in how long?
Thirteen years. And Ella Langley swept with Choosin' Texas.
Ella Langley took home a record six awards, apparently.
Choosin' Texas is everywhere, so I'm not shocked at all.
My kid sings it in the car every single morning.
Still can't believe Taylor went back to country for a night.
I'm watching the clips on my lunch tomorrow, no spoilers.
Too late, it was great. Just hit play.

items.title: Robert Pattinson announced as new James Bond
chats: Okay, did you hear? Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond.
Seriously? The guy from Twilight and The Batman?
Batman to Bond. Not a bad career path at all.
So is Pattinson a good pick for Bond or not?
I think he'll be great. He's got that brooding thing down.
I needed someone taller, but fine, I'll allow it.
Shaken, not stirred, coffee for me this afternoon.
Mister Pattinson, we've been expecting you.
I'm rewatching The Batman tonight to prepare.

items.title: 2027 Grammy nominations: Raye leads with 11, Angine de Poitrine score 4 — including best new artist
chats: Grammy nominations are out. Raye leads with eleven.
Eleven? That's a huge haul.
Angine de Poitrine got four, including best new artist.
Who do you think wins best new artist this year?
Honestly, I need to listen to half these names first.
Same. Time to update the playlist.
Made a Grammy nominee playlist for the drive home.
Send it over, my radio presets are getting stale.
Raye is first on the list, obviously.

items.title: ‘Gilmore Girls: A Day In The Life’ Gets New Home On Hulu After Netflix Deal Ends, Release Date Set
chats: Apparently the Gilmore Girls revival is moving to Hulu.
So the whole series is finally in one place?
Yep, ten years after it first came out on Christmas Day.
Have you ever watched Gilmore Girls start to finish?
Twice. It's the coziest show ever made.
Perfect fit for a fireplace company, honestly.
Coffee refill. Very Lorelai of me.
A full rewatch is my winter plan by the fire.
Count me in, I'll bring the snacks.

items.title: Nathan Fielder lookalike contest crowns a deadpan winner
chats: Did you see the Nathan Fielder lookalike contest in Toronto?
Ha, how do you even judge that?
Business pitches and a staring contest, apparently.
Could you win a staring contest against a Fielder lookalike?
No chance. I'd crack up in five seconds.
The deadpan winner earned that title for sure.
Just gave my best deadpan face in that meeting.
Nobody noticed, so you might be a natural.
Toronto next year, we're entering you.
